body.title: Publish sc4's companion-slot contract (types only)
body.summary: Publish the contract s3 OWNS and s4 consumes: CompanionVisualKind ('diagram' | 'experience'), the three-state CompanionSlotState, CompanionSlotFactory<TRecord> and CompanionLinkOut. Two deliberate widenings over the HLD sketch: `body` typed `unknown` to match sc2's shipped StructuredRenderer<T> (docs-review-panel.ts:343-348), and `linkOut` optional on BOTH non-absent states, because the reviewer whose diagram could not be drawn is the one who most needs the authentic file. Type-only, consumed by nothing yet, so s4's dependency lands independently of any diagram-specific decision.
acceptanceChecks: The 'absent' state carries NO other member, so no caller can read a label, body or link from it — k3's never-reserve-space rule as a type guarantee rather than a convention

CompanionVisualKind's mapping is TOTAL over the closed CompanionKind union: 'diagram-mermaid' and 'diagram-html' → 'diagram', 'ux-mock' → 'experience'; a new union member would be a compile error here, not an unlabelled slot
`linkOut` is declared optional on BOTH 'rendered' and 'unshowable'
`body: unknown` matches the shipped StructuredRenderer<T> return shape rather than introducing an HTMLElement bound a source string cannot satisfy
tsc passes with no change to any existing type

tests.name: sc4 types: the 'absent' state carries no label, body or link — a type-level assertion that nothing downstream can read one
sc4 types: CompanionVisualKind's mapping is TOTAL over the closed CompanionKind union (exhaustiveness, no bare default)
sc4 types: linkOut is optional on BOTH 'rendered' and 'unshowable'
sc4 types: body is `unknown`, matching the shipped StructuredRenderer<T> return shape
